author: blu
body: Proves trample. A 4/4 trampler blocked by a 2/2 assigns 2 lethal to the blocker and tramples the other 2 over to the defending player (life 20 -> 18); a 4/4 without trample deals its excess to no one (life stays 20). resolve-blocked previously never trickled excess through, so tramplers hit like vanilla beaters.
